input.summary: New York law; exclusive jurisdiction of New York County courts in place of mandatory arbitration
input.comment: [Playbook] We have moved governing law from Arizona to New York and replaced the mandatory arbitration mechanic with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, per our governing-law position; Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: in accordance with the laws of the Arizona
ops.newText: in accordance with the laws of the State of New York

ops.oldText: will be subject to and resolved by binding arbitration pursuant to the Arbitration Rules of U.S. Arbitration & Mediation, (www.usam.com). Any award or order rendered by the arbitrator may be confirmed as a judgment or order in any state or federal court of competent jurisdiction, which includes within the federal judicial district of the residence of the party against whom such award or order was entered.
ops.newText: will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.
